policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.fairness_rule: Actor, reward critic and state-value risk critic architecture/initialization remain exactly as RCWA v3. V4 adds one risk-specific scalar action-value critic Q_tail(s,a), with the same (256,128) hidden widths as the existing risk critic and a zero-initialized output head. It receives no extra environment interaction.

objective.primary: maximize expected water return, equivalently minimize expected controllable postplant irrigation

risk_constraint.grouping: Each eta is estimated independently from exactly 18 equally weighted training weather-year episodes per update.
risk_constraint.tau_estimator: For each eta and update, tau is the empirical lower-alpha quantile: the ceil(alpha*n)-th smallest retention. With n=18 and alpha=0.20 this is the fourth-smallest retention.
risk_constraint.actor_risk_constant_omitted: The eta-tau term is constant with respect to the action distribution when tau is frozen at the batch optimum; by the envelope argument it is omitted from the actor/risk-critic return to avoid score-function variance.
risk_constraint.exact_contract_check: The Rockafellar-Uryasev value at empirical tau must numerically equal the exact fractional order-statistic estimator from awm-risk-contract-v1.

lagrangian.primal_order: Freeze lambda_k, tau_k and all tail assignments for the complete PPO update; update actor/reward critic/risk critic; then update duals to lambda_{k+1}.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.advantage_normalization: standardize reward and tail-risk components before dual weighting; do not standardize the combined advantage after applying lambda
optimizer.risk_advantage_conditioning: standardize A_tail_risk independently within each eta group so collapsed low-retention batches retain directional tail contrast
optimizer.gradient_clipping: clip actor, reward critic, and risk critic parameter groups independently at max_grad_norm=0.5 before the shared Adam step
optimizer.v2_rationale: Preserve exact lower-CVaR/RU semantics while preventing tiny tail-hinge scale, post-combination normalization, random initial risk baseline, and critic spikes from suppressing primal risk response.

tail_credit.episode_tail_cost: h=(1/alpha)*max(tau-R,0), identical to RCWA v1-v3 and frozen after the 54-episode rollout.
tail_credit.risk_value_target: Monte-Carlo complete-episode risk return h_i on every transition (gamma=1), identical to RCWA v3.
tail_credit.risk_critic_prefit: Before actor PPO optimization, fit ONLY V_tail(s) to the frozen MC risk returns on the same on-policy batch.
tail_credit.risk_credit_prefit_learning_rate: optimizer.learning_rate (1e-4), existing shared Adam; actor/reward critic receive no gradients.
tail_credit.tail_q_definition: Q_tail(s_t,a_t) approximates E[h_i | s_t,a_t] under the current on-policy data.
tail_credit.tail_q_action: a_t is the sampled hierarchical behavior action before WaterBudgetController projection: gate g_t plus active-only amount_fraction u_t=(tanh(raw_amount_t)+1)/2; u_t=0 for no-op.
tail_credit.tail_q_target: the same Monte-Carlo complete-episode tail return h_i used by V_tail; no bootstrapping and no new tail label.
tail_credit.tail_q_prefit: After V_tail prefit, fit ONLY Q_tail to the same frozen MC risk returns on the same 6750 transitions.
tail_credit.tail_q_prefit_epochs_rationale: Matched to optimizer.update_epochs and V-tail prefit epochs; not tuned independently.
tail_credit.tail_q_prefit_learning_rate: optimizer.learning_rate (1e-4), existing shared Adam; Q_tail is appended after all v3 parameters.
tail_credit.tail_q_prefit_gradient_clipping: clip only Q_tail gradients at max_grad_norm=0.5
tail_credit.actor_credit: A_tail(s,a)=Q_tail(s,a)-E_{a_prime~pi(.|s)}[Q_tail(s,a_prime)]; Bernoulli gate expectation exact, active amount expectation by fixed 128-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; computed under no_grad after v4-identical prefits and detached for PPO.
tail_credit.actor_credit_combination: A_actor=z_global(A_reward)-lambda_eta*z_within_eta(A_tail), identical v2/v3 component conditioning after replacing the tail-credit tensor.
tail_credit.actor_credit_frozen: Q_tail and V_tail are not recomputed for actor credit during PPO minibatch epochs.
tail_credit.main_ppo_q_update: Q_tail receives no gradient during the main PPO epochs; its only updates are the prefit steps before actor credit is frozen.
tail_credit.long_horizon_rationale: The Q target is the full remaining episodic tail outcome h_i rather than a one-step bootstrapped TD residual, while explicit action input lets the critic model gate/amount dependence.
tail_credit.no_schedule_prior: No conventional schedule, stage threshold, DAP pacing penalty, reward shaping, action-frequency reweighting, weather split/cross-fit, dynamic CVaR, distributional return critic or extra expected-shortfall objective is introduced.
tail_credit.policy_q_baseline: V_Q(s)=(1-p_gate)Q(s,[0,0])+p_gate*E_{z~N(mu,sigma)}Q(s,[1,(tanh(z)+1)/2]). The same frozen Q_tail supplies observed Q and baseline; independent V_tail is not subtracted from actor credit.
tail_credit.policy_q_baseline_quadrature: Fixed 128-point Gauss-Hermite numerical integration, not tuned against training or validation outcomes; no policy RNG is consumed.
tail_credit.risk_critic_role: V_tail prefit/value-loss/checkpoint behavior is preserved exactly from v4 for isolation and diagnostics, but V_tail is not used in actor risk-credit subtraction.

rollout.risk_assignment_time: after all 54 episodes are collected and before PPO optimization

interaction_budget.fairness_rule: Exactly the same maximum training interaction budget as PPO v1 and PPO-Lagrangian v1; risk estimation and dual updates use only the existing 54 rollout episodes.

change_rule: RCWA v4 is a new protocol derived from v3 forensic evidence. Relative to v3, the scientific mechanism change is action-conditioned long-horizon tail credit: add scalar Q_tail(s,a), prefit it to the unchanged Monte-Carlo episode tail cost, and use Q_tail-V_tail as actor tail advantage instead of the one-step Tail-TD residual. All lower-CVaR semantics, dual hyperparameters, actor/reward/risk-value architecture, interaction budget, seeds, checkpoint cadence, water budget and evaluation protocol remain unchanged.
